prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Design Your Companion's Official Blueprint", "Customize your pet's name, personality, and adoption certificate standard.", "Finalize Adoption Blueprint", "Companion Name"]
1: ["Your Pet is Ready for Desktop Action!", "Use taskbar tray controls and hotkeys anytime to call or hide your pet companion."]
2: ["Sign In to Sync & Secure Your Pet Save", "Connect your cloud account to preserve pet memory across re-installs and updates.", "Signing in ensures your pet state is saved safely to cloud storage."]
3: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Discover how your pet lives on your desktop, assists your day, and reacts to your workflow.", "Choose My Path", "Select Your Onboarding Speed", "Pick quick instant companion adoption or create a custom pet tailored to your photos."]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Rendering Environment", "We are generating companion animations and testing desktop overlay compatibility.", "Desktop Render Verification"]
5: ["Upload Pet Photos for 3D Generation", "Provide clear front and side photos for best custom pet visual accuracy.", "Front View Photo", "Side Angle Photo"]
6: ["Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to minimize, feed, or pause your pet.", "System Tray Active"]
7: ["How Would You Like to Pick Your Pet?", "Choose Instant Adoption to start immediately, or Custom Creator to build from photos.", "Continue With Selected Path"]
8: ["Secure Your Companion & Prevent Data Loss", "Link your account now to permanently save your pet's memory, items, and personality to the cloud.", "Your pet progress is bound to this sign-in account.", "Sign In & Protect Save"]
9: ["Generating Your Pet in Background", "You can switch to other windows. We will play a sound and alert you when your pet is ready on desktop."]
